subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add an additive native `announceTarget` contract for `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, and should `parent` mean an internal parent-session wake with no direct channel completion announce?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix chooses public model-facing tool and config semantics across session-state and message-delivery boundaries.

options.title: Approve narrow announceTarget
options.body: Add `channel | parent` with current behavior as the default, implement parent routing as internal handoff, and coordinate separately with suppression/per-channel policy.

options.title: Unify into broader announce policy
options.body: Design one completion policy that covers channel, parent, skip, and per-channel variants before implementation.

options.title: Defer core surface
options.body: Keep existing callback workarounds until maintainers settle a broader A2A handoff contract.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow announceTarget
recommendation.body: Add `channel | parent` with current behavior as the default, implement parent routing as internal handoff, and coordinate separately with suppression/per-channel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central tool and has the strongest current history across spawn, announce, delivery, docs, and compatibility-sensitive agent runtime decisions.
